title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, University Of California on 1982-05-22

ai_review.summary: Professional remastered soundboard capture of a splendid 1982 performance with engaging playing and high energy from the opening Jack Straw.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about an exceptionally strong show, citing consistent engagement night after night and a fine‑tuned Vista Cruiser that propelled the band forward. The recording is praised as a professional Jeff Norman remaster with crystal‑clear soundboard quality, making it a dance‑able listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both an outstanding musical performance and top‑tier remastered soundboard audio, warranting a high rating despite limited data points.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Professional Jeff Norman remaster described as crystal‑clear, no noted flaws; the sbd source suggests a clean mix from the console.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic opening with Jack Straw leading into a consistently engaging set that maintained momentum throughout.
